arabic text: ASHOOR KA SURAJ HAI
english translation text: THE SUN OF ASHURA IS GLOWING

arabic text: AA AY MERE HUSSAIN MERE GODH MAY AAJA\nAAJA MERE BACHCHE MERI AAGHOSH MAY AAJA
english translation text: O MY HUSSAIN! COME INTO MY LAP\nCOME MY CHILD, COME INTO MY ARMS

arabic text: ASHOOR KA SURAJ HAI QAYAMAT KI GHADI HAI\nBHAI KA GALA KAT-THA BEHAN DEKH RAHI HAI\nMAKHTAL MAY KISI MAA KI SADA GOONJ RAHI HAI
english translation text: THE SUN OF ASHURA IS GLOWING, THE HOUR OF CALAMATIES IS HERE\nTHE SISTER IS WATCHING HER BROTHER'S NECK BEING SEVERED\nA MOTHER'S CRY (SYEDA FATIMA S.A.) IS ECHOING IN THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: MERE LIYE AY LAAL TU ASGHAR KI TARHA HAI\nGODI MERI GEHWAARA HAI BISTAR KI TARHA HAI\nIS DHOOP MAY DAAMAN MERA CHADAR KI TARHA HAI
english translation text: O MY SON! YOU ARE LIKE ALI ASGHER FOR ME\nMY LAP IS LIKE A CRADLE AND BED FOR YOU\nIN THIS SCORCHING SUN, MY CLOTHES ARE A COVER FOR YOU

arabic text: MAI MAA HOON MERA DIL NAHI SENAY MAY SAMBHALTA\nNAZUK YEH BADAN TERA YEH JALTA HUA SEHRA\nAUR IS PE SITAM YEH HAI KE TU REHGAYA PYAASA
english translation text: I AM A MOTHER, MY HEART CANNOT BE CONTAINED IN MY CHEST\nYOUR FRAIL BODY IN THIS BURNING DESERT\nAND THE BIGGEST CALAMITY IS THAT YOU REMAIN THIRSTY

arabic text: MAI GODH MAY LELU TUJHE SEENAY SE LAGALOON\nSEENE PE SAKINA KI TARHA TUJH KO SULALOON\nSEENE KE TERE TEER MAI PALKO SE NIKAALOON
english translation text: I WILL TAKE YOU IN MY LAP, AND HUG YOU TO MY CHEST\nI WILL PUT YOU TO SLEEP ON MY CHEST LIKE SAKINA\nI WILL GENTLY TAKE OUT THE ARROWS FROM YOUR CHEST

arabic text: AAKAR MERE ZAANU PE JO SOJAATE THAY BETA\nCHAKKI KI MASHAKHAT PE BHI PEHLU NAHI BADLA\nAB KAISE TUJHE CHOD DOO MAKHTAL MAY AKELA
english translation text: WHEN YOU USED TO COME AND SLEEP IN MY LAP\nI NEVER MOVED IN SPITE OF THE DIFFCULTY IN GRINDING THE GRAIN\nNOW HOW I CAN LEAVE YOU ALL ALONE IN THIS BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: TERI BHI TO AULAAD HAI TU BHI TO PADAR HAI\nAULAAD KA GHAM KYA HAI YEH TUJH KO BHI KHABAR HAI\nGHAM BACHCHE KA SEHJAYE YEH KIS MAA KA JIGAR HAI
english translation text: YOU ALSO HAVE CHILDREN, YOU ARE ALSO A FATHER\nYOU KNOW WHAT IT IS TO SUFFER THE PAIN OF ONE'S CHILD\nWHICH MOTHER IS ABLE TO ENDURE THE GRIEF OF HER CHILD

arabic text: TU LAYT-GAYA THAK KAY TO IS JALTI ZAMEEN PAR\nYEH KISKA LAHOO TUNE MALA ROOYE-HASEEN PAR\nMAT KHAAKH PE SO LAAL TERI MAA HAI YAHI PAR
english translation text: YOU LAY DOWN ON THE BURNING SAND FROM SHEER EXHAUSTION\nWHOSE BLOOD HAVE YOU SMEARED ON YOUR BEAUTIFUL FACE\nDO NOT SLEEP ON THE SAND MY SON, YOUR MOTHER IS HERE

arabic text: JO DIL PE TERE GUZRI MAI SAB DEKH RAHI THI\nHAR LAASH UTHAANE MAI TERE SAATH GAYI THI\nAB BAAT WOH KEHTI HOON JO BACHPAN MAY KAHI THI
english translation text: I CAN SEE WHATEVER YOU ARE SUFFERING IN YOUR HEART\nI FOLLOWED YOU EVERY TIME YOU WENT TO PICK UP THE BODY OF A MARTYR\nNOW I WILL SAY WHAT I USED TO TELL YOU IN YOUR CHILDHOOD

arabic text: ASHUR KA SURAJ HAY, KAYAMAT KI GHARI HAY\nBHAYE KA, GALAA KAT-TA, BAHAN DEKH RAHI HAY\nMAQTAL ME KISI MAA KI, SADAA GOONJ RAHI HAY
english translation text: THE SUN OF ASHURA HAS RISEN, IT IS AN HOUR OF DOOM\nA BROTHER'S THROAT IS BEING CUT WHILE HIS SISTER WATCHES\nIN THE BATTLEFIELD, A MOTHER'S CRY ECHOES

arabic text: AA AEY MERE HUSSAIN MERI GOAD MAY AA JAA.\nAA JA, MERE BACHE, MERI AAGHOSH MAY AA JA
english translation text: OH MY HUSSAIN, COME INTO MY LAP,\nCOME MY CHILD, COME INTO MY ARMS

arabic text: MAIN GOAD MAY LAYLOON, TUJHE SEENEY SE LAGAA LOON,\nSEENEY PE SAKINA KI TARHA TUJKO SULAA LOON,\nSEENEY KE TERE TEER MAIN PALKO SE NIKALOON,
english translation text: LET ME TAKE YOU INTO MY LAP, LET ME HUG YOU,\nON MY CHEST, LET ME PUT YOU TO SLEEP LIKE SAKINA\nLET ME REMOVE THE ARROWS FROM YOUR CHEST WITH THE LASHES OF MY EYES.

arabic text: AAKAR MERE ZAANU PE JO SO JAA\nCHAKKI KI MUSHAKKAT KE BHI PEHLU NAHI BADLAA,\nAB KAISE TUJHE CHOR DU MAQTAL MAY AKELA,
english translation text:
TE THEY BETA,
THE WAY YOU USED TO COME AND SLEEP ON MY SHOULDER MY SON,
EVEN THROUGH (YOUR MOTHER'S) TOILING, YOU DID NOT TURN AWAY FROM MY LAP
NOW HOW CAN I LEAVE YOU ALONE IN THE BATTLEFIELD?

arabic text: TU LAIT GAYA THAK KE TU IS JALTI ZAMIN PAR,\nYE KISKA LAHU TU NAY MALAA ROOHE HASII PAR,\nMAT KHAKH PE SO LAAL TERI MAA HAI YAHEEN PAR,
english translation text: YOU HAVE LAID DOWN EXHAUSTED ON THIS BURNING GROUND,\nWHOSE BLOOD IS THIS THAT YOU HAVE WIPED ON YOUR FACE?\nDON'T SLEEP ON THE GROUND SON, YOUR MOTHER IS RIGHT HERE.

arabic text: JO DIL PE TERE GUZRI MAIN SUB DEKHRAHI THI,\nHAR LAASH UTHANE MAIN TEREY SAATH GAYI THI,\nAB BAAT WO KEHTI TUJO BACHPAN ME KAHI THI,
english translation text: WHAT YOU HAVE GONE THROUGH, I HAVE BEEN WATCHING,\nI WENT WITH YOU TO PICK UP EVERY BODY,\nNOW I'M SAYING TO YOU, THAT WHICH I USED TO TELL YOU IN YOUR CHILDHOOD.

arabic text: MAKTAL ME KISI MAA KI, SADAA GUNJ-E RAHI HAI. AA E MERE HUSAIN-E MERI GOD-E ME
english translation text: A MOTHER'S CRIES ARE ECHOING IN THE BATTLEFIELD.\nOH MY HUSSAIN, COME INTO MY LAP

arabic text: AAJAA, MERE BACHE, MERI AA GOSH-E ME AAJAA
english translation text: COME MY SON, COME INTO MY LAP

arabic text: ME MAA HU MERA DIL, NAHI SIN-E ME SAMBHALTA.
english translation text: I AM YOUR MOTHER, MY HEART IS NOT EASY IN MY CHEST

arabic text: NAZUK-E YE BADAN TE RA YE JALTA HUWA SEHRA.
english translation text: YOUR DELICATE BODY,\nAND THIS BURNING DESERT

arabic text: MAY GOAD MAY LAYLOON TUJHE SINAY SE LAGAA LOON
english translation text: LET ME TAKE YOU INTO MY LAP, HUG YOU TO MY CHEST

arabic text: SINE PE SAKINA KI TARHA TUJKO SULAALU.SINE ME TERETIR-E ME PALKO SE NIKALU.
english translation text: LET ME PUT YOU TO SLEEP ON MY CHEST, JUST LIKE SAKINA

arabic text: SINAY KE TERE TIR MAY PALKO SE NIKALU
english translation text: LET ME GENTLY REMOVE THE ARROWS FROM YOUR CHEST

arabic text: GHAM BACHCHE KA SEHJAYE YE KIS MAA KAJIGAR HE.\nAA JA MERE BACHE MERI AAGHOSH MAY AA JAA
english translation text: WHICH MOTHER'S HEART CAN BEAR THE GRIEF OF A LOST CHILD?\nCOME MY SON, COME INTO MY LAP

arabic text: KYU LAIT GAYA THAKKE KE TU ISEJALTI ZAMIN PAR.
english translation text: WHY HAVE YOU LAID DOWN, TIRED ONTO THIS BURNING GROUND?

arabic text: ABBAT-E WO KEHTI TUJO BACH-E PAN ME KAHI THI.
english translation text: NOW I WILL SAY, WHAT I SAID TO YOU IN CHILDHOOD
